caps: Why did Hanuman bring | the *WHOLE MOUNTAIN?*
lines.tts: Why did Hanuman bring the whole mountain?

caps: In Valmiki's Ramayana, | *RAVANA* hurls a spear
made by Maya, | ringing with *EIGHT BELLS.*
lines.tts: In Valmiki's Ramayana, Ravana hurls a spear made by Maya, ringing with eight bells.

caps: It strikes *LAKSHMAN* | in the chest. | He falls.
lines.tts: It strikes Lakshman in the chest. He falls.

caps: Ram pulls it out | and breaks it, | then weeps: | *WHAT WILL I TELL MOTHER SUMITRA?*
lines.tts: Ram pulls it out and breaks it, then weeps: What will I tell mother Sumitra?

caps: The vaidya *SUSHENA* looks closer: | his face hasn't darkened. | *HE'S ALIVE!*
lines.tts: The vaidya Sushena looks closer: his face hasn't darkened. He's alive!

caps: Bring four herbs | from *MOUNT MAHODAYA.* | *GO, HANUMAN!*
lines.tts: Bring four herbs from Mount Mahodaya. Go, Hanuman!

caps: But up there, | Hanuman can't tell | *ONE HERB FROM ANOTHER.*
lines.tts: But up there, Hanuman can't tell one herb from another.

caps: So he shakes the peak | *THREE TIMES,* | and brings | *THE WHOLE THING!*
lines.tts: So he shakes the peak three times, and brings the whole thing!

caps: Sushena crushes the herbs. | Lakshman breathes them in, | *AND RISES!*
lines.tts: Sushena crushes the herbs. Lakshman breathes them in, and rises!

caps: And most people don't know: | this was his | *SECOND MOUNTAIN.*
lines.tts: And most people don't know: this was his second mountain.

caps: The first time, | the herbs *HID* from him.
So he took that mountain too, | and later | *CARRIED IT BACK!*
lines.tts: The first time, the herbs hid from him. So he took that mountain too, and later carried it back!

caps: Did you know | Hanuman did it *TWICE?*
lines.tts: Did you know Hanuman did it twice? Comment yes, or no!
